args.prompt:
Create a NEW KFB claymation ink-blob sheet using the two attached original benchmarks solely for anatomy, clay surface, and sculpted eyes. Exactly six complete independent footless characters in three columns by two rows. Landscape 1536×1024 PNG. TRUE transparent alpha-zero background in all gaps and margins. No white matte, floor, vignette, scenery, large backdrop screens, shadow discs, labels, grid lines, real organization logos or national badges. Biohazard Isolation crew. Shared kit: mustard-yellow sealed collar rings, dull olive gloves integrated into goo, wide raised clear helmet rims, moss-green fittings. Top row Sample Detail, bottom row Isolation Detail. Each blob is a separate character with a full standalone silhouette at comparable scale. Art direction: richly tactile dark charcoal-plum satin clay with soft highlights, round organic goo bodies and short goo hands. Equipment rests directly against the clay body with chunky rounded shapes. Keep each full face unobstructed, including white ivory sclera, distinct red iris and black pupil, dark sculpted lids and dark ink lips. Protective hoods have wide open face rings or a clear visor raised above the forehead. Two subtly female-read figures in cells 2 and 5. Mouth and body silhouette vary deliberately. Teeth sit within an open mouth. No human torso, legs, boots or rigid armor. Props: a Hypernormalization Screen is a little portable slab the character holds beside its body, with dark smoked glass and a chunky rim. A dangerous card is a sealed abstract blank card with one tiny dark corner mark. No lettering. Keep all silhouettes including droplets and equipment in their cells, with generous air around each. Row-major direction:
1. Male-read cautious collector. small capped glass sample tube in a thick olive cradle. tall pear with an uneasy single raised brow.
2. Female-read brisk seal inspector. stubby olive seam-checking roller. wide scalloped blob with focused sideways eyes.
3. Male-read overprepared courier. sealed squat specimen jar with an abstract dark fleck inside. round lump with wide eyes and a small worried mouth.
4. Male-read stern isolation lead. compact portable Hypernormalization Screen with chunky mustard frame and smoked green inset. broad squared blob, hard sideways gaze.
5. Female-read quietly alert card custodian. one blank ivory card in a small sealed clear case. lean curved blob, guarded eyes and tight mouth.
6. Male-read patient rinse technician. short scrub brush and capped rinse flask. low broad blob, heavy lids and dry smile.
Make the theme readable at thumbnail size. Render all six as independent character cutouts with true alpha.

material_change: Same accepted gentle charcoal/plum satin clay direction; no stronger correction and no generated style parent.
